given: a stock table containing a mix of conforming and nonconforming inventory_code values after backfill
then: it surfaces the count of rows that did not parse as location-batch-serial (those left with NULL batch_number and serial_number) for review before the change is accepted

independence.rationale: AC3 asserts nonconforming rows are left NULL; this asserts a separate observable output — a reviewable count of those rows. A build could correctly NULL nonconforming rows yet never report how many there were.

architectural_notes: Infra: a contract on an observable integrity-probe output computed from data-store state, verified by seeding a known mix of conforming/nonconforming codes on the paired Lakebase branch and asserting the reported count. Realized as a read-only probe (a post-migration verification query / service.repository read counting rows where batch_number and serial_number are NULL) — it mutates nothing and surfaces the nonconforming count for human review before the change is accepted. Cross-cutting concern: migration observability / acceptance-gate reporting under R1, owned by the probe (repository read), never the domain model.
